name: Campeiro Bulldog
independentEvidence: CBKC 2025 standard calls for a robust medium-sized dog, head without excessive wrinkles/loose skin; however it explicitly allows thick hanging lips and requires a nonexcessive dewlap. Mastiff type itself is its FCI section, so that label is not a valid rejection reason.
actualVisualObservation: The native head has several deep forehead folds and bulky pendulous cheek/neck skin. Body is robust and moderate enough; the skin excess is the supported concern, not body mass alone. Four paws/tail and crop are coherent.
recommendation: Targeted regeneration is reasonable to reduce excess forehead folds and neck skin while retaining permitted lips and moderate dewlap; avoid claiming all jowls/dewlap are wrong. Lead should confirm subjectively excessive skin before call.

name: Jack Russell Terrier
independentEvidence: FCI345 distinguishes rectangular shorter Jack Russell from square taller Parson and calls for roughly equal body depth and elbow-to-ground height.
actualVisualObservation: At native resolution the trunk is longer than tall after allowing for oblique camera angle; foreleg below elbow is not clearly longer than trunk depth. Four coherent paws, white broken coat, button ears and tail are correct. Pose does not establish a Parson identity.
recommendation: Retain. A preferred lower/longer rendition would be aesthetic refinement; audit has not established an exact-identity defect from this oblique view.

name: Romanian Bucovina Shepherd
independentEvidence: FCI357 allows black patches with red-fawn reflections and requires black nose. Coat photographs/renderings cannot reliably establish pigment genetics.
actualVisualObservation: Native image has very dark almost-black muzzle/nose, dark ears and brown-red lit surfaces on head and body patches. These can reasonably depict permitted black with red-fawn reflections. Large guardian structure, straight body hair, mane and full tail match.
recommendation: Retain: brown/liver genotype and an excluded coat are not established by these pixels. Preserve nuance rather than treating every warm dark patch as chocolate.

name: Cursinu
independentEvidence: SCC standard explicitly allows short or medium well-furnished hair and some feathering; it does not require a sleek single coat.
actualVisualObservation: Native image shows medium rather than long body hair, modest roughness at neck and limbs, visible clean leg contours, a furnished tail and fawn brindle. It does not have a long shaggy coat hiding anatomy.
recommendation: Retain; evidence does not establish coat outside allowed medium/feathered range. Scope this as interpretive uncertainty, not verified error.

name: Euskal Artzain Txakurra (variedad Gorbeiakoa)
independentEvidence: RSCE head section limits the very-short hair phrase to the head. The tail section permits long hair, and the coat section describes moderately long soft body hair, short smooth face/front legs and rear-leg fringes. The audit incorrectly treats a head clause as a whole-coat clause.
actualVisualObservation: The native portrait has red soft body coat, short face and front legs, fringed rear legs and long-haired tail. Its visible silhouette is consistent with the actual scoped standard. No confirmed identity defect.
recommendation: Retain portrait. Correct audit interpretation; do not regenerate to an incorrectly smooth whole-body coat.

name: King Charles Spaniel, Tricolour
independentEvidence: FCI128 requires a well-domed skull full above eyes, a clearly defined stop and short upturned nose/muzzle.
actualVisualObservation: Native portrait is compact with short legs and a relatively short broad muzzle, so calling it unequivocally a Cavalier overstates the evidence. Nevertheless the upper skull is relatively flat and the muzzle projects forward with weak upward turn; breed-defining domed head is underexpressed. Colour, four paws/tail and crop are coherent.
recommendation: Targeted regeneration to a clearly domed skull and short broad upturned muzzle is supported as head-type correction. Preserve healthy visible nostrils, natural eyes and correct tricolour. Do not overstate existing dog as proven Cavalier.
